### 3. American University Washington College of Law (AU WCL)
* **Dedicated PIPS Scholarship Page:**
  * URL: `https://www.american.edu/wcl/impact/initiatives-programs/publicinterest/pipsscholarship/index.cfm`

  * The **Public Interest / Public Service (PIPS) Scholarship** is a full-tuition, 3-year scholarship awarded to incoming (1L) full-time JD students. **Top Recommendation:** Contact **American University Washington College of Law (AU WCL)** first if institutional funding is a major decision driver, but start immediate admissions outreach with **University of Baltimore**.

1. **Why AU WCL for Funding Strategy:**  
   The PIPS Scholarship at AU WCL offers complete **full-tuition coverage for all three years**, but it has an early competitive deadline (**January 31, 2027**) with an explicit recommendation to test by November. Because this requires tailored essays and an early application file, reaching out to AU WCL's admissions and financial aid offices now will ensure your application strategy aligns with the PIPS timeline.
2. **Why UBalt for Admissions Outreach:**  
   UBalt makes personal outreach the easiest and fastest of the three: you can directly self-schedule a dedicated **1-on-1 30-minute consultation** on their live calendar starting right away.
3. **Why UMD Carey for Programmatic Overview:**  
   UMD Carey Law is ideal for low-pressure structured learning via their interactive webinar series starting **September 24, 2026**, giving you a direct line to ask admissions questions in real time.

* **University of Baltimore School of Law:**
  * **Next Action:** Go to Tab `2136412449` (`https://forms.lsac-unite.org/5810/UBaltLawPhoneCallFall2026.html`) and select an upcoming Wednesday/Thursday 30-minute slot for a 1-on-1 call with an admissions counselor, or email `lawadmissions@ubalt.edu` / call `(410) 837-4459`.
* **University of Maryland Carey Law:**
  * **Next Action:** Go to Tab `2136412448` (`https://forms.lsac-unite.org/5814/ProspectsWebinar92426.html`) to register for the September 24 "Mock Application Review & AMA" webinar, and complete the JD inquiry form (`https://forms.lsac-unite.org/5814/2027ProspectiveApplicantInquiryForm.html`).
